name: nD Hyper-iso-surface Orientation by Induction
definition: Definition 7 (hypercube or 2^n-cell): A 0D point is a 0D hypercube. A 1D unit line segment is a 1D hypercube. An nD (n-1)D hypercube is translated along the nth mutually perpendicular direction with a unit vector tracing out an nD hypercube.
